meta.title: Is Golden Bridge Worth the Hype?🤔We fell in love with BaNa Hills, DaNang❤️
meta.description:
Hi Cuties! 🥹❤️

Welcome to our Da Nang vlog! After exploring the beautiful island of Phu Quoc, we flew to Da Nang with Sun Phu Quoc Airways and started the next chapter of our Vietnam trip. ✈️🇻🇳

Da Nang instantly stole our hearts — beautiful beaches, ocean views, amazing food and such a relaxed vibe! 🌊✨ We stayed at a beautiful hotel right by the ocean, with the most gorgeous sea-facing views.

On Day 2, we headed to the famous Ba Na Hills! 🏔️✨ We’ll take you along as we explore Ba Na Hills, the French Village, the iconic Golden Bridge and, of course, try the Alpine Coaster! 🎢

We’ve also shared the ticket details and costs below so you can plan your own Ba Na Hills trip:

🎟️ Ba Na Hills admission ticket:
From ₹3,430 per person on Klook

🎢 Alpine Coaster:
From ₹254 per person on Klook

🎟️ Ba Na Hills + Alpine Coaster combo:
Klook also offers combo tickets, with the price varying depending on the date and package selected.

Prices on Klook can change depending on the date, offers and availability, so please check the latest price before booking.

We also explored the famous Golden Bridge, took the cable cars up the mountains, walked around the beautiful French Village and experienced everything Ba Na Hills has to offer.

And of course… the BIG question — Is the Golden Bridge actually worth the hype? 👀

Come spend our first two days in Da Nang with us and find out! ❤️

📍 Places covered:
• Da Nang
• Our ocean-facing hotel
• Ba Na Hills
• Golden Bridge
• French Village
• Alpine Coaster

If you enjoyed the vlog, don’t forget to LIKE, COMMENT & SUBSCRIBE! 🥰

Love,
Neha & Tejas ❤️
